component.name: NT Task Manager
component.summary: Processes, services and load in a classic shape

description.p: A system monitor laid out like the task manager of the mid-nineties: a process list with CPU and memory usage, the services of the system, and load meters with a running graph beside them.

The window draws nothing by itself. Its appearance comes from the widget style and the colour scheme of the system, so it follows whatever theme is set instead of imposing one. Under a period theme it looks the part; under Breeze it looks like Breeze.
It needs nothing but Qt. What it shows and where it comes from:

ul.li: Processes, CPU time and memory from /proc
Graphics card load from NVML on NVIDIA, from sysfs on AMD

description.p: First release. Processes, services, performance and networking.
